description: READ-ONLY. Price a swap of one token for another out of the app wallet, routed by Jupiter. The quote already includes the DFM platform fee, so `outAmount` is what the user actually receives — do not subtract a fee again when you report it. Amounts are RAW base units as a string (a u64 does not fit a JS number). Use this before `swap` so the human sees the rate first. For DEPOSITING into a fund use `deposit`, not this.

amountRaw.description: RAW base units of inputMint to sell (respect that mint's decimals).

slippageBps.description: Slippage tolerance in bps; defaults to 50 (0.5%).

name: swap_quote
title: Quote a token → token swap (app wallet)
